$comment: Generic secret shapes only; this deployment's own identifiers are not published.
$copyRootComment: Root files copied verbatim from the private tree (round-9 security, 2026-09-19). `.npmrc` used to be one of them: a registry file is where an auth token lands (`//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=`), and the scanner had no pattern for one, so a token added to the private root would have been published on the next sync. The public tree gets the fixed two-line file in template/ instead, and this list is for files whose content is only tooling settings.
$patternsComment: The token classes this repository actually holds (round-9 security, 2026-09-19): npm automation (the release workflow's NPM_TOKEN), Resend (mail), a Telegram bot token, and a PEM smuggled into a single line as \n-escaped text, which the multi-line pattern above cannot see.
